headline: Chinese investments in Morocco hit $2.8 billion driven by EV battery industry
summary: Rhodium Group data shows Chinese firms completed $2.8 billion in Moroccan projects between Jan 2025 and June 2026, accounting for 60% of their 10-year total in the country.
why: Morocco is emerging as a regional industrial hub for electric vehicle battery materials due to its trade agreements and mineral deposits.

impacts.name: Morocco
impacts.why: Surging foreign direct investment strengthens industrial capacity in green technology.
